description:
Just like the Inception, the Spire uses an aftermarket grade full chromoly frame with a double-butted down tube. It's also spec'd with just about every aftermarket part we make - Sub 10 V2 stem, Gnar Star sprocket, Premium 16-spline cranks, Street tires and Counterfeit grips. This is as close to a custom build as you're going to get without going into quadruple digits.
Full chromoly frame with double-butted down tube, Mid BB, welded integrated seat clamp
Full chromoly forks with tapered legs
Full chromoly bars 8" (on 20.5") or 8.25" (on 21") with Sub-10 V2 CNC-machined alloy front load stem
Premium full chromoly 175mm 16-spline cranks with sealed Mid BB
Premium Gnar Star 25T CNC-machined alloy sprocket
Odyssey Twisted plastic pedals
Premium Street tires; 2.25" front, 2.0" rear
Premium Fat Capitol with forged pivotal post

components.description: Premium 16 spline full Crmo 175mm w/Sealed MID BB
Full Crmo - 8" rise w/20.5" frame, 8.25" rise w/21" frame
36H alloy sealed 3/8" Frt, 36H Alloy sealed cassette rear 14mm w/9T driver
Alienation 36h Deviant dw front/36h Black Sheep dw rear, 36H alloy sealed 3/8" Frt, 36H Alloy sealed cassette rear 14mm w/9T driver
Premium Fat Capitol Pivotal seat with Pivotal post
